name: Laser Point Sensor
description: The closest point to the center of the sensor's field of view will be reported. It outputs a value of -1 to 1 on composite number channel 1 for the x position, and a value of -1 to 1 on composite number channel 2 for the y position. Composite on/off channel 1 is set to on when a point is visible. The -1 to 1 values map to an fov of -cos(0.5) to cos(0.5) in both the x and y directions.
shortDescription: A sensor that outputs a relative x and y position of a laser point that it can see within its field of view.

logicNodes.label: Wavelength
logicNodes.description: The specific light wavelength to detect (whole number).

logicNodes.label: Data Output
logicNodes.description: On/Off channel 1: is laser detected. Number channel 1, 2: X, Y position within the sensors 120 degree field of view.
